verdict.rationale: Mangopay's own API covers user management, with a published OpenAPI spec and SDKs. Its verification docs say platforms must integrate hosted KYC/KYB for all user types, so onboarding runs through a Mangopay-hosted flow rather than being clearly completable end to end by an agent over the API. The probed MCP server lives on the docs domain, and there is no evidence it exposes seller-operation tools. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for creating seller accounts, programmatic tracking of requirements-due or verification states, an MCP surface for operations (not just docs), scoped/restricted API credentials, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run seller operations — create accounts, drive onboarding to completion, and answer requirements-due states through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials
